cases.question: What is the annual remote work equipment stipend?
cases.answer: The remote work equipment allowance is $500 per calendar year [doc-hr-policy].
contexts: Employees are eligible for up to $500 per calendar year for home office equipment reimbursement under the remote work policy.
cases.reference_answer: Employees receive a $500 annual stipend for remote work equipment.

cases.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
cases.answer: Full-time employees receive 15 days of paid annual leave per year [doc-leave-policy].
contexts: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of paid annual leave per full calendar year of employment.
cases.reference_answer: Full-time employees are entitled to 15 paid annual leave days each year.

cases.question: Can I bring my pet iguana to the office?
cases.answer: I do not have information in the provided policies regarding exotic pets in the office.
contexts: Only certified service animals are permitted on company premises.
cases.reference_answer: The policy only allows certified service animals, not pets.
